snippet.title: Last Pirates: Die Together | Teaser Trailer - Coop Horror Game 2026
snippet.description:
Our Steam page is officially LIVE! 🚀 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4317790/Last_Pirates_die_together/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=anno

Last Pirates: Die Together is a 4-player co-op horror where you play as scallywags trying to break the curse by returning all stolen treasures. But you have these weird, "stretchy hands" physics that let you dismantle and grab almost anything on the island.

GET ON THE LIST! ⚓
Sign up for our newsletter for an invite to the Closed Playtest coming this Spring 2026: tinyurl.com/bdcskhps

🏴‍☠️ Twitter: https://x.com/RetroStyleGames
🏴‍☠️ TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@l.p.coop

And remember: NO PREY, NO PAY! 💰
